query:
SELECT t.TABLE_NAME, t.TABLE_ROWS,
  GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(c.COLUMN_NAME, ':', c.COLUMN_TYPE, ':', IF(c.IS_NULLABLE='NO','NOT NULL','NULL'), ':', IFNULL(c.COLUMN_DEFAULT,'')) ORDER BY c.ORDINAL_POSITION SEPARATOR '||') as col_defs
FROM information_schema.TABLES t
LEFT JOIN information_schema.COLUMNS c 
  ON c.TABLE_SCHEMA = t.TABLE_SCHEMA AND c.TABLE_NAME = t.TABLE_NAME
WHERE t.TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
AND t.TABLE_NAME IN (
  'accord_ingredients', 'accord_notes', 'accord_ratings', 'accord_versions',
  'axes', 'axis_molecules', 'axis_plants', 'axis_tags',
  'blend_components', 'blend_notes', 'blend_ratings', 'blends',
  'cannabis_terpene_profiles', 'cannabis_variety_molecules',
  'collection_items', 'collections',
  'distillation_batches', 'distillation_notes',
  'drying_methods', 'drying_profiles',
  'fermentation_batches', 'fermentation_notes',
  'field_notes', 'field_observations'
)
GROUP BY t.TABLE_NAME, t.TABLE_ROWS
ORDER BY t.TABLE_NAME;
